title: WebAssembly in 60 seconds
caption: WebAssembly in 60 seconds: running code written in Rust, C++ or Go inside the browser, close to native speed.

scenes.say: For years, the browser ran one language: JavaScript. WebAssembly lets it run code from many others.

items.title: Compile
items.say: You compile your code to a compact binary format.

items.title: Fast
items.say: The browser runs it close to native speed.

items.title: Sandboxed
items.text: same safety as a web page
items.say: In the same sandbox as any web page.

scenes.say: It's how heavy apps like video editors and design tools run in a tab, and it's spreading to servers too.
That's WebAssembly. Many languages, one browser tab.
